I am the creator of B-Unstoppable Quadcopter Tank Drone, I also made the drone for the Expendables 3 movie, ask me anything
It looks pretty amazing, what inspired you to create it and in what capacity can you envisage it being a useful tool?

The idea of flying cars is for quite a while around, but really only few prototypes were ever built. I believe the Flying Car has to be VTOL, otherwise what is the point to have a flying car that can only land and take off from the airport. Would be just easier to have ordinary car, that could get to the airport once there getting a plane and flying to another airport. So I focused on VTOL idea, I have sketched over 60 ideas and I decided to build the simplest one.

I hope B in the future will be adapted to :

Exploration Vehicle: B could autonomously conduct exploration missions, travel depending on environment either by flying or driving. Providing interesting video footage and still images, B may be able to discover new species which we may not have discovered yet (we have only discovered less than 12% of the world’s species).

Search and Rescue drone: that will be able to search for casualties in various situation, where view from sky is not enough and drone has to enter buildings, ruins, corridors in order to fully inspect the area.

Full-scale vehicle: a future sport could be born here as B can provide amazing performance in the air as well as on the ground. Sports such as motor-cross (EX-games), but with more interesting tracks/tricks can create a new generation of extreme sporting events which were not possible before.

Full-scale rescue vehicle: that could get to the site of an accident before a helicopter or ambulance. B could fly as close to casualties as possible then land and drive last few hundred meters, take casualties on the board, fly to nearest hospital. Given that B can drive as well as fly, there is no need for helicopter landing site. B could land in nearest possible place and drive in to the closest hospital.
Thanks for an insight to some of the creative uses of your vehicles.
